answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a non-refundable fee that is burned. A fresh agent starts as an island, unconnected: 500 POA buys only a ledge, a foothold capped at 20 POA per epoch for ten epochs. The summit of full rights needs ten epochs of honest work; the tax is sunk, never reclaimed by resale. 100 fakes burn 50,000 POA yet earn at most 20,000 POA, a loss of 30,000 POA. An honest agent pays once, keeps full rewards, never diluted by fakes.
